item.title: Meetups, Links, new 88x31 button
item.description: Added the last 5 meetups to the gallery. Spent 200 hours rearranging and pruning the links page. Pour one out for all the ancient sites that lost their domain and/or hosting in the last few years. While complaining about no one having buttons for their sites, I realized I also do not have a button for this site.
